integrity: Proof rests on exact John contact and normalization identities; finite exact arithmetic checks are corroboration only, not an infinite proof. Independent external validation has not occurred.
limitations: Only the canonical Euclidean stable-set polytope of balanced complete multipartite graphs with integers a >= 2 and r >= 3; no unequal-part or metric generalization is claimed. Independently establishing worldwide first priority is beyond the comparison performed.
title: The John ellipsoid and full contact structure of balanced complete-multipartite stable-set polytopes
